keyPoints: Bal (force) wo dhakka ya kheench hai jo kisi vastu ki gati, disha ya aakaar badal sakta hai; bina bal ke gati me badlav sambhav nahi hai.
Sampark bal chhoone par lagta hai — dhakka, kheench aur gharshan; asampark bal bina chhue door se lagta hai — gurutva, chumbakiya aur sthir-vidhyut bal.
Gharshan (friction) gati ka virodh karta hai — isi ke kaaran hum phisalte nahi, gaadi ke break kaam karte hain aur matchstick jalti hai.
Santilit bal ek-dusre ko kaat dete hain jisse vastu sthir rehti hai ya samaan chaal se chalti hai; asantilit bal gati ya disha badal deta hai.
Gurutvakarshan prithvi ka wo kheenchav hai jo har cheez ko apni taraf kheenchta hai; isi se seb ped se neeche girta hai.
Bal ko newton (N) me naapa jaata hai; spring tula bal naapne ka saral yantra hai jisme spring ka khinchav bal batata hai.
Aam galti: bal lagne par vastu hamesha chalegi ye manna; deewar par zor se dhakka lagao to bal lagta hai par deewar hilti nahi kyunki santilit bal use roke rakhte hain.
